panel.headline: Embedded C1 is proved on both vacuum examples. Applying the trapped-orbit theorem requires a physical bounce band.

summary: The same two embedded Dommaschk tori have zero net toroidal current, absolute transform at least 0.2386 and off-QA defect at most 0.0063 and 0.0090 times the absolute transform on C and A respectively. Embedded C1 also holds on the rational stellarator KAM torus. A separate annular theorem constructs a radial label and trajectories confined through time c/ε² under averaged tangency and nonsingularity. A volume-filling flux chart, thermal-particle confinement and performance on the Dommaschk candidate remain open. One checked family on the same embedded tori contains the full pilot action calibration and 1,570 signed slabs across all eight endpoints. At u=0.478 the true trajectory stays submirror through 4 radians each way, with a field-strength margin exceeding 1/270000. The submirror sign holds on all 317 incoming tubes in each direction. At u=0.470 a physical field line through the original Dommaschk birth covers all 782 signed slabs with position error below 3.327 × 10⁻⁶. At this launch, each admitted birth satisfies the regular arclength mirror predicate throughout the closed archive height band. Dimensionless one-way flight time is between 54.98668 and 264 throughout the closed band and above 57.80606 at its upper endpoint. The action between the first mirrors has the one-way flight time as its height derivative and lies between 0.2765 and 1.357790458 at the upper end. The regular births have positive four-dimensional Cartesian position-height volume. For compatible open support, energy and pitch cuts, each sign of parallel velocity also has positive five-dimensional trapped-reference volume. For each positive displacement cap, one local time works simultaneously for the full ±316/64 arcs through every admitted pilot launch phase, both velocity signs, all certified heights and a compatible positive closed energy interval. A preselected measurable finite trapped reference with an open-positive law and a nonempty compact axis has a strictly positive covered fraction. The time and fraction have no numerical lower bounds yet. In the nonzero vacuum region the effective parallel field is exactly the field strength. The certified angle-height rectangle at this radial label has area about 1.972 × 10⁻⁹. The two original field lines satisfy the field-strength and arclength estimates at every common angle through ±4 radians. The complete 325-pair tube comparison, combined with a second signed trajectory through its first mirrors, would give an action secant above 1/3.

tasks.model-contracts:I1: Partially implemented — algebraic force balance and tangency; positive permeability and actual differential laws in the restricted slab model.
tasks.model-contracts:I2: Lean verified — uniform-field and nonzero-current force-free witnesses in the Cartesian slab model; not toroidal confinement.
tasks.model-contracts:I3: Partially implemented — common-witness contracts and an assumption ledger; full decoded candidate identity remains pending.
tasks.model-contracts:I4: Partially implemented — interval containment, continuous clearance, and exact whole-box slab margin; text parsing and general signed multiplication remain pending.
tasks.model-contracts:I5: Partially implemented — conditional conservation and coercivity bounds for continuous symmetric forms on one normed space; no MHD PDE bridge.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G1: Lean verified — field/current tangency and uniform-field witness; the analytic instance is Cartesian, not toroidal.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G4: Partially implemented — Lipschitz-cover clearance at every parameter point; Fourier bounds, regularity, and embedding certificates remain pending.
tasks.plasma-models-and-equilibrium:E1: Lean verified — exact Solov'ev (a tokamak model), helical, validated slab, and Landreman families 1 (zero shear) and 2 (proved shear) finite-β non-axisymmetric equilibria satisfy the kernel ForceBalance law with actual Ampère current and a real pressure gradient (Design/ForceBalanceGradient); family 1 is a Grad counterexample (family1_grad_counterexample, infrastructure). Under the contract both Landreman families carry net toroidal current, so they fail C1.
tasks.mhd-stability:S1: Partially implemented — abstract energy conservation and norm bounds conditional on a differentiable solution; same-space variant only.
tasks.mhd-stability:S3: Partially implemented — scalar two-channel Young drive inequality; integral MHD identity and geometric coercivity remain pending.
tasks.mhd-stability:S4: Partially implemented — exact neutral-drift counterexample; the MHD quotient and admissible-space characterization remain pending.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K3: Partially implemented — 3.5 MeV alpha orbits in an exact Solov'ev field (a tokamak model) exist and are all confined for all time (reactor_alpha_born_confined); passing alpha guiding centres confined for all time in an exact vacuum stellarator field (Littlejohn model): μ = 0 over B₀R₀ ∈ [67.95, 69.99] T·m, every λ ∈ [0, 1/4] at one energy and B₀R₀ (on-demand), a ±0.4 eV × λ ∈ [0, 1/16] window (on-demand); near-QA passing alphas 0.19 s for orbits off the axis, with existence on the full horizon only for a band of births. One species, mostly passing: part of C2 at most; trapped alphas open.
tasks.verified-numerics:N1: Partially implemented — exact mantissa/scale decoding, interval containment, addition, negation, and nonnegative products; no text parser yet.
tasks.verified-numerics:N2: Partially implemented — continuous Lipschitz-cover clearance; Fourier and tail estimates remain pending.
tasks.verified-numerics:N3: Partially implemented — exact two-block checker plus a polynomial interval checker (kernel decide) proving Riccati/Jacobi certificates; proof-term certificate predicates (Kronecker, Boolean-checker, digit-sum and term-evaluation certificates, sound by induction) now replace most decide +kernel checks; matrix factorization pending.
tasks.verified-numerics:N4: Lean verified — local contraction existence/uniqueness, radii inequalities, and the injective equation bridge; operator-specific bounds are hypotheses.
tasks.verified-numerics:N5: Lean verified — nonlinear scalar x²=2 validation on [1,2], with residual 1/12 and Lipschitz constant 1/3; not a plasma PDE.
tasks.verified-numerics:N9: Partially implemented — common-witness composition and restriction of uncertainty sets; candidate decoding and physical feedback closure remain pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D1: Partially implemented — filament integral, bounds, actual Fréchet derivative, and source-free Maxwell identities (∇·B=0 for any filament, ∇×B=0 for closed filaments) away from the source; higher derivatives pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D2: Lean verified — exact circular-loop vector field on its axis and orientation reversal; the two-loop fixture has a positive midpoint field for positive equal currents.
tasks.coils-and-design:D3: Partially implemented — arbitrary 3-D placed circles preserve C¹ regularity, closure and simplicity; tube envelopes have continuous clearance/disjointness and manufacturing-margin transfer. Embedded winding packs and self-clearance remain pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D5: Partially implemented — full-parameter position/tangent errors imply a C⁰ filament-field error; current errors compose with the same coils; a concrete polygonal coil set confines field lines for 52 transits (coil_stellarator_confined_concrete_N, field-line existence assumed); the coil-field KAM certificate is vacuous (Q-2); Cᵏ field-error bounds for k ≥ 1 pending.
tasks.vacuum-demonstrator:VD1: Partially implemented — primary CNT design/error-field sources reviewed and arbitrary 3-D circle poses formalized; a complete versioned four-coil placement/current dataset has not been frozen.
tasks.vacuum-demonstrator:VD2: Partially implemented — fixture fields with derivatives, error budgets and now proved source-free Maxwell identities for closed filaments; not yet a four-coil stellarator.
tasks.vacuum-demonstrator:VD4: Partially implemented — the rational vacuum field has an embedded C1 torus with ι ≈ 0.137 and a separate all-time field-line confinement proof. There is a residence bound for the probe and a 52-transit result for a coil-produced field. Coil-produced all-time confinement remains open (Q-2).
tasks.materials-and-engineering:M2: Partially implemented — slab existence, uniqueness, maximum, whole-box bound and exact 998/45 K synthetic margin; coolant-flow identity remains pending.
tasks.roadmap:P0: honest kernel: Partially implemented — limited MHD/thermal law bundles, analytic witnesses, counterexamples, and a dated assumption ledger; no full 3-D domain model.
tasks.roadmap:P1: useful exact building blocks: Partially implemented — energy, intervals, contraction, clearance, filament field and slab thermal results; remaining field/engineering targets are explicit.
tasks.roadmap:P2: continuous vacuum candidate: Partially implemented — two-loop fixture with derivatives, error budgets, clearance and Maxwell identities; an exact non-axisymmetric vacuum field with all-time field-line confinement; a polygonal coil set with 52 certified transits; finite conductors pending.

tasks.roadmap:6: Partially implemented — current linearity, loop formula, actual field-integral differentiation, perturbation bounds and source-free Maxwell identities.
tasks.roadmap:7: Lean verified — scalar block checker and polynomial interval checker with Riccati/Jacobi stability certificates; no MHD tail estimate.
tasks.roadmap:8: Partially implemented — common-witness contracts; decoded geometry identity, source data and complete candidate ledger remain pending.
tasks.plasma-models-and-equilibrium:E3: Partially implemented — an exact Solov'ev solution is verified directly against J×B=∇p (Δ*ψ=3R² checked by hand only); general Grad–Shafranov equivalence pending. A helical (JFKO-type) exact equilibrium is also verified.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G2: Partially implemented — divergence/curl operators with sanity lemmas; Clebsch fields ∇ψ×∇χ are divergence-free for C² potentials; reciprocal-basis identities pending.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G9: Lean verified (vacuum model) — all-time field-line confinement in the exact rational stellarator field via a verified KAM theorem, with global existence and uniqueness of field lines proved (no remaining hypotheses); 0.077 ≤ ρ ≤ 0.19.
tasks.mhd-stability:S6: Partially implemented — Suydam both ways; Mercier certified for the reactor Solov'ev equilibrium (tokamak model) and on a band k ∈ [0.7, 0.9] of Landreman family 2 at λ = 200 (family2_mercier_stable_derived; Mercier formula supplied); helical equilibrium and family 1 proved Mercier-unstable. C3 status: family 2 carries net toroidal current (fails C1), so nothing yet for a current-free candidate.
tasks.mhd-stability:S7: Partially implemented — screw-pinch Newcomb stability for every mode m ≠ 0 (Newcomb's reduced form supplied; with radial balance, stable_all_modes_equilibrium); ideal ballooning of the reactor Solov'ev equilibrium (tokamak model) on every flux surface (reduction supplied); family-2 ballooning reduced to one pointwise certificate (numerically stable, not certified); no 3-D all-mode certificate.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K1: Lean verified — Newton–Lorentz energy and speed conservation, exact uniform-field gyration, Larmor-radius formula and realistic exact bounds.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K2: Partially implemented — Noether conservation of canonical momentum for any Killing symmetry (rotation, translation, helix) for full orbits; reduced Hamiltonian theory pending.
tasks.roadmap:P3: confined reduced orbits: Partially implemented — passing 3.5 MeV alpha guiding centres confined for all time in the exact vacuum stellarator field (Littlejohn model); full-orbit alphas in a Solov'ev tokamak model (orbits proved to exist); near-QA passing alphas 0.19 s off the axis. Contract: this gate feeds C2, which needs thermal ions and electrons (open).
tasks.roadmap:P4: finite-pressure equilibrium: Partially implemented — exact Solov'ev (tokamak model), helical and Landreman families 1 and 2 (finite β, non-axisymmetric, net toroidal current) satisfy the kernel law; contract C4 at finite β for a current-free equilibrium is open (Q-20).
tasks.roadmap:P5: all-mode MHD result: Partially implemented — Suydam both directions; screw-pinch Newcomb δW ≥ 0 for every mode m ≠ 0 (reduced form supplied, wall at edge); Mercier and ballooning (reductions supplied) only on C1-failing test beds; no all-mode 3-D result (C3).
tasks.implementation-plan:M0: Lean verified — exact slab, screw-pinch, Solov'ev and helical equilibria with kernel force balance, all-time field-line/orbit confinement, Suydam both ways and screw-pinch Newcomb stability for every m ≠ 0 (reduced form supplied; idealized symmetric models).
tasks.implementation-plan:M1: Lean verified — 0-D D-T burn with fuel dilution: T ∈ [10,30] keV for all t ≥ 0 under IPB98(y,2) (ITER-like, P_aux ∈ [50,70] MW, H ∈ [1.25,2]); nominal H ≤ 1 proved insufficient in this flat-profile model; ignition point in (12,13) keV, unstable; Bosch–Hale class non-vacuous.
tasks.implementation-plan:M2: Lean verified (idealized, tokamak model) — one field with a pressure-budget band on the actual Solov'ev flux geometry: driven, high-Q (Q≈40) and ignited versions; for every supplied classical transport solution (existence not proved) two-sided bands and pressure ≤ p_eq + offset (a budget, not equality). Contract C5 only on a tokamak model.
tasks.implementation-plan:M3: Partially implemented — ℓ¹ Banach algebra with exp, radii polynomial, Fourier regularity; a validated slab Grad–Shafranov equilibrium with exponential pressure profile (classical C², kernel ForceBalance, positive pressure); toroidal (2-D) validation pending.
tasks.implementation-plan:M4: Partially implemented — passing 3.5 MeV alphas in reactor-scale near-axis QA stay inside for 0.19 s (Boozer GC model, orbits off the axis); such orbits exist on the full horizon for a band of births (0.05 s) and on ≈ 1.5 μs near the axis; trapped alphas open.
tasks.implementation-plan:M5: Partially implemented — exact non-axisymmetric vacuum stellarator field with all-time field-line confinement (verified KAM, existence proved); concrete coil-produced field certified for 52 toroidal transits; coil-produced all-time confinement pending.
tasks.plasma-models-and-equilibrium:E6: Partially implemented — no piecewise-smooth existence theorem; the sourced smooth explicit Landreman families are formalized, and family1_grad_counterexample proves nested toroidal level sets, non-constant pressure and no continuous Euclidean symmetry (C4 test bed; carries net current).
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G5: Partially implemented — one example, not the general theorem: for Landreman family 1 every level set ψ = c ∈ (0, δ] is homeomorphic to Circle × Circle (torusMap, inside family1_grad_counterexample).
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G7: Partially implemented — a different characterization: weak quasisymmetry (WeakQS, qsDefect, qsDefect_eq_zero_iff, axis lemma); the Landreman families are proved not weakly quasisymmetric. The Fourier characterization and omnigeneity (C2) remain open.
tasks.verified-numerics:N8: Lean verified (vacuum model field) — KAM invariant-torus certificates (torusA_exact, rationalStellarator_confined_forever_exists) and guiding-centre tori are compiled; finite-time field-line certificates (95 and 52 transits); the coil-field torus is blocked (Q-2).
